findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a mop to be stored in soiled mop water in the back room of the facility. Education was conducted regarding mop storage, and the mop was moved to the straining basin of the bucket. Ensure the mop head is stored in a manner that allows for dripping and air-drying when not in use. Storing the mop in soiled water can result in contamination of the mop with microbial growth.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Observed employee handle use cell phone and then continue working without washing hands. Wash handles anytime they become contaminated.

2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed sanitizer solution at front counter to test at 100 ppm quaternary ammonia. Solution was remade and tested at 200 ppm. 

4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
Observed several (20+) house flies present throughout the facility. Reduce and or eliminate flies in facility. 

6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 
One half gallon of skim milk is found in the 2 door cooler in back at 51F. The milk had been sitting out during the rush and they were cooling it down. The milk was discarded down the sink. Take care to keep cold food cold.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface. 
The ceiling over the reverse osmosis system is missing a tile. There has been work done in the facility recently. According to the manager on duty, a pipe was dropped through this area. Replace the ceiling tile in this area.
